parameters.name: X509Certificate
parameters.description:
The X.509 certificate in the PEM format.

The certificate is provided by the SAML identity provider (IdP).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso add-external-saml-idp-certificate --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --x509-certificate MIIC8DCCAdigAwIBAgIQP9eomUYGeoND0000 --region cn-hangzhou
